name: How can I make my new shower more accessible or senior-friendly?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my new shower more accessible or senior-friendly?

acceptedAnswer.text: To enhance shower accessibility, consider a curbless entry or low-threshold design to eliminate steps, making it easier for wheelchairs or walkers. Installing grab bars, a built-in or fold-down shower seat, and an adjustable-height handheld showerhead are also key. Non-slip flooring is essential. City Dweller can help design and install these features to create a safer, more comfortable showering experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Increase accessibility with curbless entry, grab bars, shower seats, handheld showerheads, and non-slip flooring. City Dweller can incorporate these features.
